key_reasoning.reason: Change spans three components (LangGraphAssistantBuilder in assistant_engine_builder.py, the AssistantFactory job/pool helpers in assistant_factory.py, and the new SUBAGENT_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS config) across the Service and Infrastructure/config layers, and introduces a shared build-job abstraction (run_builds/SubagentBuildContext) reused by both the custom and builtin subagent paths.

Concurrent build orchestration (ThreadPoolExecutor + contextvars.copy_context, per-thread DB session reset via _current_session.set(None), fatal-vs-non-fatal cancellation semantics) is a new application of an otherwise well-established pooling pattern (ThreadPoolExecutor already used in 24 other files). Code comments flag real race-condition concerns -- e.g. deep-copying toolkits/mcp_servers/context on the builtin clone specifically to avoid races once builtin builds run concurrently. Performance is the explicit primary goal of the change (reducing pre-stream latency), which is a Technical Risk red flag.

Most of that volume is docs artifacts carried over from the prior 2026-10-20-epmcdme-15952-concurrent-subagent-executors task directory (plan/spec/technical-analysis/complexity/gate-run/decisions/code-review json+md files) rather than source code -- only 3 source files and 4 test files are functionally changed -- but the rule scores the raw diffstat count as given.
